summary: Program bundles hash the same wherever the subject tree and its dependencies are checked out

rules.detail: No runtime or policy rule changes.

compatibility.detail: fractal/tree builds program bundles with --minify-whitespace, so every program mission's bundle sha256, and with it its rendered declaration, changes once on the next render. Before, a tree whose dependencies sit outside it (linked node_modules) rendered a different bundle hash from every checkout location.

downtime.detail: No runtime deployment or migration changes.

manual.detail: No user action is required; publishers republish program missions once with the new bundle.

recovery.detail: Reverting restores the previous bundle bytes; bundles already published stay pinned by their own sha256.
